data_a.situation: Twenty-two crowns on job QM-2031-0468 have to be re-blocked after a press fault, and the coordinator has drafted an update to the workroom manager.
known_facts: The press fault in the Ardhu Lane annexe flattened the crowns on 22 pieces for Ashvale Bridal House.
Re-blocking 22 crowns takes about two full days of one blocker's bench time.
Ilva Renaudin's bench hours next week are already committed to the Marchmont Enclosure sample.
Callum Ostrey is not on the Saturday rota and has not been asked about Saturday.
The rush surcharge on QM-2031-0468 is 480 pounds and appears on Ashvale's order.
The revised delivery note for QM-2031-0468 has not been drawn up.
constraints: Waiving a surcharge is a decision for the commercial lead or the workroom manager.
Weekend shifts and any re-allocation of another maker's hours are agreed by the workroom manager.
The coordinator does not commit the workroom manager's signature.

turns.input_raw:
Quick check on this before it goes to Marit.
